definitions: A collaborative workspace within the Canva platform where multiple users can share designs, assets, and brand kits, and work together on projects.
A group of individuals who have joined forces on Canva to streamline their design workflow and maintain brand consistency across various projects.
examples: Our Canva Team collaborated on the new marketing campaign.
Managing brand assets is easier with a dedicated Canva Team.
She invited all designers to the Canva Team.
